connector.name: Audit Ledger MCP
connector.registryDescription: Record AI decisions to a tamper-evident audit ledger from any MCP-compatible agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package audit-ledger-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shahidh68 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AUDIT_API_URL
env.description: Your deployed audit-ledger API endpoint (e.g. https://<api-id>.execute-api.<region>.amazonaws.com/prod). Leave unset to run in sandbox mode against the public shared tenant.

env.name: AUDIT_WRITE_KEY
env.description: Tenant write key for your deployed ledger. Required if AUDIT_API_URL is set and you want to call record_decision.

env.name: AUDIT_READ_KEY
env.description: Tenant read key for your deployed ledger. Required if AUDIT_API_URL is set and you want to call verify_decision or list_decisions.

env.name: AUDIT_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

env.name: AUDIT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
env.description: Number of retry attempts on transient failures. Defaults to 3.

env.name: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY
env.description: Tenant secret used to HMAC-SHA256 PII and prompts locally before sending. Generate once per tenant (e.g. node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))") and keep it in your environment. The key never leaves your process. If unset, the MCP falls back to plain SHA-256 for backwards compatibility and logs a one-time deprecation warning; set this to switch to keyed hashing, which regulators (ICO/EDPB) expect for pseudonymisation.
